blocks.title: Balanced tree
blocks.text: Balanced tree apni height jitni kam ho sake rakhta hai: kisi bhi node ki baen aur daen shaakhon ki height mein farq muqarrar had, aam taur par 1, se zyada nahi hota. Is se talash, dakhila aur hatana O(log n) ke qareeb rehte hain.

Library kitabon ko qismon ke mutabiq rakh sakti hai: jarr Science, us ke bachche Physics aur Biology, phir Physics ke Classical Mechanics aur Quantum Physics aur Biology ke Botany aur Zoology, aur koi shaakh doosron se bohat lambi nahi. Quantum Physics dhoondne ke liye Science, phir Physics, phir Quantum Physics; kyunke height qismon ki tadaad ke logarithm jitni rehti hai, talash jaldi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Mutawazin tree lambi zanjeer ban jane wale tree se talash mein tez kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Mutawazin tree mein root se kisi bhi node tak raasta taqreeban log n qadam hai; zanjeer mein n qadam ho sakta hai, list ki talash ki tarah.

items: Balanced tree: shaakhon ki heights mein zyada se zyada taqreeban 1 farq; amal O(log n) ke qareeb.
